description: shotcraft gates: (1) PreToolUse guard: raw Higgsfield generation from Bash always goes through sc.py gen (reads such as model list/get, generate cost, account and auth status pass); Higgsfield MCP tools that generate, create, upscale, edit, train or upload are blocked while a project is active; project.json, .shotcraft/stages.json and .shotcraft/qa/ change only through sc.py; files go into a stage folder only while that stage is open (00_inputs/ and .shotcraft/lessons.md are always allowed). (2) SessionStart: a daily Higgsfield model check, stale routing rows, and the active project with its open stage. (3) UserPromptSubmit: while a project is active, a reminder to log the user's corrections as lessons.
